changelog:
Initial release of whatsapp-local-router, a skill for routing WhatsApp inputs to local HTTP endpoints.

- Routes plain text messages to POST /process and QR image messages to POST /decode-qr on localhost.
- Forwards backend JSON responses directly to the user without formatting changes.
- Invokes backend via a shell script, returning stdout or raw error responses.
- Prioritizes image (QR) decoding if both image and text are present.
- Enforces a 20-second request timeout.
- Preserves input text exactly as received.
summary: Route incoming WhatsApp content to local HTTP endpoints and return endpoint JSON directly to the user. Use when a WhatsApp message contains plain text/random...
